descriptions.zh:
你们好，忠诚的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们做的很不错。在我们的引领下，你们已经掌握了超空间旅行的科技，第一次准备好要探索群星……正如我们曾经所做的一般，那是无数纪元以前了。

不要害怕——如果我们不觉得你们已经准备好了，我们是不会任已经发生的事件带领你们一路走到这里的。现在就出发，成为我们的骄傲吧。
descriptions.en:
Hello, faithful [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You have done well for yourselves. With our guidance, you have mastered the technology of hyperspace travel and are now ready to set off into the stars for the first time... much as we once did, countless eons ago.

Have no fear - if we did not think you ready, we would not have allowed events to carry you as far as they have. Go now, and make us proud.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。实验的第一阶段成功完成——我们已经指引你们发展出了你们文明的第一台[GetStartingDrivePlural]，现在你们已经准备好了探索群星。

放心吧，要知道第二阶段已经开始，我们会继续监督你们的进展。迄今为止，你们已经证明了自己格外机敏。和其他生物完全不同。

观察你们能用这一机会做到什么将会很有意思。
descriptions.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The first phase of the experiment has successfully concluded - we have guided you towards the development of your civilization's first [GetStartingDrivePlural], and you are now ready to take to the stars.

Rest assured in the knowledge that we will continue to monitor your progress now that the second phase has begun. Thus far, you have proven remarkably adroit. Not at all like the others.

It will be interesting to see what you make of this opportunity.

descriptions.zh:
从[from.GetName]的船员发回了一封紧急讯息，在[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]星系中找到了§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!。

“[fromfrom.GetName]”……光是这个名字本身就已是传奇，有许多传说都是从摹照[overlord.GetName]流传下来的。[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]们都知道这个地方是天堂，是无形的希望的灯塔。尽管我们肉眼可见其神圣性，但我们现在也面临着一个残酷的事实：这个神话般的圣地在现实中确实存在。

[overlord.GetName]还没有对我们的发现发表任何言论，但我们发现了他们非常密切地关注着这颗星球的证据。他们知道我们在这里，我们不知道如何解释他们对此一言不发。
descriptions.en:
Priority dispatch from the crew of [from.GetName], in the [fromfrom.solar_system.GetName] system: we have found §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!.

"[fromfrom.GetName]"... Its very name is the stuff of legends, many of which were handed down in scripture from the [overlord.GetName]. Many [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] know this place to be paradise - a beacon of intangible hope - and though we can see that it is indeed divine, we are now also faced with a blunt fact: this mythical, holy place actually exists.

The [overlord.GetName] have yet to say anything about our discovery, but we found evidence that they watch this world very closely. They know we are here; we do not know how to interpret their silence.

label.zh: 我们的先辈显然信任着我们。
label.en: Our elders clearly have faith in us.

descriptions.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]上可远远不止是有着丰富的资源和原始的生态系统。[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]星系中的这颗[fromfrom.GetClassAdj]星球除了在高轨道上有一个古老的、闪闪发光的信标外，它没有受到过任何影响。

这件装置高度的复杂性甚至可以比肩[overlord.GetAdj]的科技；因此我们相信这座信标属于附近的[spi_fallen_empire.GetName]。至于其作用：我们尚无法完全确定，但似乎[spi_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]将这颗星球视作神圣。
descriptions.en:
There is more to [fromfrom.GetName] than rich resources and a pristine ecosphere. This [fromfrom.GetClassAdj] world in the [fromfrom.solar_system.GetName] system lies untouched save for an ancient, gleaming marker buoy in high orbit.

The sheer sophistication of this device parallels that of even [overlord.GetAdj] technology; we therefore believe the marker belongs to the nearby [spi_fallen_empire.GetName]. As to its purpose: we cannot say for sure, but it seems likely the [spi_fallen_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural] consider this world to be holy.

descriptions.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]上可远远不止是有着丰富的资源和原始的生态系统。[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]星系中的这颗[fromfrom.GetClassAdj]星球除了在高轨道上有一个古老的、闪闪发光的信标外，它没有受到过任何影响。

这件装置高度的复杂性甚至可以比肩[overlord.GetAdj]的科技，然而其设计却截然外物。因此我们只能假定这座信标属于现存或过去存在过的某个与他们相当的文明。按其外表所刻蚀的许多符号判断，它似乎用于标定一处圣地。
descriptions.en:
There is more to [fromfrom.GetName] than rich resources and a pristine ecosphere. This [fromfrom.GetClassAdj] world in the [fromfrom.solar_system.GetName] system lies untouched save for an ancient, gleaming marker buoy in high orbit.

The sheer sophistication of this device parallels that of even [overlord.GetAdj] technology, however its design is distinctly alien. We must therefore assume the marker belongs to some contemporary of theirs, past or present. Judging by the various symbols etched onto its exterior: it may even be marking out a holy site.

descriptions.zh: 预兆判定你们应当因一直为我们服务接受这份礼物。不要浪费这份赠礼。
descriptions.en: The Augurs have decreed that you should receive this gift for your continued service to us. Do not squander it.

descriptions.zh: 仔细考虑过后，我们决定为实验引入另一个变量。请接受这份赠礼。随你们的意愿自行处理即可。
descriptions.en: After much deliberation, we have decided to introduce another variable to the experiment. Please accept this gift. Do with it as you will.

descriptions.zh:
亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。一如既往，我们始终保持着对你们的观察，你们的一名领袖吸引了我们的注意。事实上，你们的[desired_leader.GetTitle]，§H[desired_leader.GetName]§!的声名已经一路传到了我们的首都。

鉴于[desired_leader.GetHerHis]非比寻常的技能，我们想要为他在[scion_master.Capital.GetName]上提供一个永久的职位。一份莫大的荣耀，可以这样讲。请尽快安排好对[desired_leader.GetHerHis]的调动。
descriptions.en:
Dearest [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. As always, we have been observing you, and one of your leaders has attracted our attention. Indeed, the reputation of your [desired_leader.GetTitle], §H[desired_leader.GetName]§!, has reached all the way to our capital.

Given [desired_leader.GetHerHis] unusual skills, we would like to offer a permanent position on [scion_master.Capital.GetName]. A great honor, to be sure. Please arrange for [desired_leader.GetHerHis] transfer as soon as possible.

label.zh: 不行，这位领袖得留在我们这。
label.en: No, this leader stays with us.

options.script:
name = origin.205.b
response_text = origin.205.b.response

descriptions.zh:
你们好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。在[scion_master.Capital.GetName]上有一名相当古怪的[scion_master.GetSpeciesName]，宣称自己已经对在[scion_master.GetName]中的生活感到不耐烦——甚至可以说是厌倦！这个自以为是的家伙想要在星系里发展程度较低的文明中寻求一次挑战——按他的话来说是这样。

你会从我们这里接手[scion_master.GetSpeciesName]吗，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？就算是我们欠了你们一份情。按照他的资历，我毫不怀疑他会在你们的领导职位上有良好的表现，但你们可能要容忍他那无常又冲动的举止。
descriptions.en:
Hello, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. There is a rather eccentric [scion_master.GetSpeciesName] on [scion_master.Capital.GetName] who claims to have grown restless - even bored! - of life as it is among the [scion_master.GetName]. This deluded individual seeks a challenge - their words - among the less developed civilizations of the galaxy.

Will you take this [scion_master.GetSpeciesName] off our hands, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? You would be doing us a favor. Given their qualifications, I have no doubt they would serve you well in a leadership position, as long as you can tolerate their erratic and impulsive behavior.

label.zh: 我们没有空闲的岗位，抱歉。
label.en: We have no available positions, sorry.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们最近发现了一些没用的多余星舰。我们本打算把它们扔到最近的恒星里去，但突然想到了你们，我们亲爱的子弟。

这都是些老船了——一些甚至肯定比你们的整个文明都古老——但你们会发现它们还是颇具潜力的。收下吧，不客气。
descriptions.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we recently discovered several surplus starships that we have no use of. We were about to chuck them into the nearest sun, but then we thought of you, our dear scions.

These are old ships - some are no doubt older than your entire civilization - but you should find them quite potent. Please take them. We insist.

tooltips.en: A small fleet of [scion_master.GetSpeciesName] starships joins the [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……你们能不能努努力？你们的舰船也太落后了，这么磨磨蹭蹭可真令人生厌。

让你们的[root.GetScientistPlural]看看这些引擎的说明书吧。不客气。
descriptions.en:
Dear [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... Would you care to pick up the pace a little? Your ships are lagging behind, and we grow tired of such dawdling.

Have your [root.GetScientistPlural] take a look at these engine specifications. We insist.

descriptions.zh:
你好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！你们觉得自己的努力还不错是吧？真好。

你们做得可真是……还行，不过我们希望你们还能百尺竿头更进一步。星系中还有那么多地盘可以吸收，而你们却如此故步自封！

别担心，因为我们已经帮你们准备好了补给包。谢就不用谢了，只要把它好好地用在新殖民地就行。
descriptions.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], hello! Do you feel your endeavors are going well? Splendid.

What you are doing is... fine, but we want to see you extend your reach a little further. There is so much more galaxy to take in, and yet you remain so cooped up!

Do not worry, though: we have prepared a supply package for you. No need to thank us; just be sure to invest it wisely in a new colony.

label.en: We cannot do that right now.

descriptions.zh:
嗟，动起来[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！不要轻易地接受失败。你就只需要挪到那儿，然后自己建个新家就好了。

快点，动啊。
descriptions.en:
Come now, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Do not admit defeat so easily. You just need to get out there, and make a new home for yourselves.

Hurry along, now.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们的通讯装置看来是坏掉了。我们不断地收到你们不知感恩的丧气话。乖乖改正行不行?
descriptions.en: Your communications apparatus must be faulty, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]: we keep receiving negative and ungrateful cross-chatter. See to that fault, won't you?

descriptions.zh:
我亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……我们该拿你怎么办哟？我们曾对你抱有如此高的期望，然而你却在这里，为了一场毫无意义的战争消磨你的潜力，而且你似乎正在输掉这场战争。[scion_master.Capital.GetName]上有许多人认为我们应当与你们断交，但是那将算是承认了我们的错误，毕竟我们曾在你们这个特殊物种身上投入不少发展上的资金。

一支小的[scion_master.GetSpeciesName]远征舰队已经置于你的指挥下。用它来结束战争——最好结局不是你灭绝。不要花太久。我们希望看到这只舰队的归来。并且，别让他们全灭！
descriptions.en:
Our dear [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... what are we to do with you? We had such high hopes, and yet here you are, squandering your potential in a pointless war that you seem to be losing. There are many on [scion_master.Capital.GetName] who think we should cut all ties with you, but that would be an admission of error. We have invested quite a bit in the development of your peculiar species, after all.

A small [scion_master.GetSpeciesName] expeditionary fleet has been placed under your command. Use it to bring some sort of conclusion to the present hostilities - preferably one that doesn't include your extinction. Do not take too long. We will want this fleet back, eventually. And do not get them all killed!

label.zh: 谢谢……我们将会好好使用他们。
label.en: Thank you... we shall put them to good use.

descriptions.zh: [scion_master.GetName]借给我们的远征舰队已被摧毁。这或许会让他们不高兴……
descriptions.en: The Expeditionary Fleet lent to us by the [scion_master.GetName] has been utterly destroyed. This will likely upset them...

descriptions.zh:
我们的舰队在哪里，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？我们借给了你们舰队去结束那场愚蠢的战争。现在它在哪？不要装傻！

§R把我们的舰队还回来！§!
descriptions.en:
Where is our fleet, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? The fleet we lent you to end your silly war. Where is it? No, do not feign ignorance!

§RGIVE US BACK OUR FLEET!§!

options.script: name = origin.53.a

descriptions.zh: 奸诈的狗杂种。现在我们要索回我们的舰队。
descriptions.en: Treacherous cur. We will be taking our fleet back now.

options.script: name = origin.29.a

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……我们的线人告知我们你所参加的战争已经结束了。既然你还站在这，所以你们一定没有被彻底毁灭。

现在我们要带回我们的舰队。请未来尽量避免无法取得胜利的军事纠纷。
descriptions.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... our informants tell us the war you were in has ended. Since you are still here, it must not have been an utter disaster.

We will be taking our fleet back now. Do your best to keep out of unwinnable military entanglements in the future, please.

options.script: name = origin.54.a

descriptions.zh: 尽管我们已经与联盟的其他成员接触了一段时日了，但唯有现在：超光速引擎的实现，让我们这几个帝国可以真真切切地互相接触。现在的问题是，我们的联邦应当专注于什么方面：一些人提倡目前的通用模式，而另一些人则倾向于专注于在特定领域进行更紧密的合作。
descriptions.en: Though we have for some time been in contact with the other members of our alliance, it is only now - with the invention of FTL drives - that our empires are able to interact with each other on a meaningful level. The question has arisen as to what our federation should focus on: some advocate the current, generalist path, whereas others would favor focusing on closer integration in a particular field.

label.en: The alliance we have is enough.

label.zh: 我们需要在敌人面前保护自己。
label.en: We must defend ourselves against those who oppose us.

label.zh: 只有共同研究才能共同进步。
label.en: Only through research can we progress.

label.zh: 我们当选择凝聚力和传统的道路。
label.en: Unity and traditionalism shall be our path.
Trade is important above all else.

descriptions.zh:
随着[Root.GetName]上的地震与火山活动的频率和烈度持续提升，我们的科学家现在可以更为准确地预计末日到来的时间：

他们估计我们在行星自身引爆前还有§H35至45年§!时间。

行星表面的条件在那之前会逐步恶化。唯一的好消息是迅猛的科技进步使得开采地幔中的丰富资源变得更为容易，提高了我们的生产能力。
descriptions.en:
As earthquakes and volcanic activity on [Root.GetName] continue to increase in frequency and intensity, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are now able to more accurately predict when the end will come:

They estimate that we have between §H35 to 45 years§! until the planet detonates.

Conditions on the surface will steadily deteriorate until then. The only good news is that the violent tectonic movements have made it easier to access the rich resources of the planet's mantle, increasing our production capacity.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]的大部分地区现在几乎每天都会发生地震，过去几年里又出现了很多新的超级火山。大量的火山灰遮蔽了天空，使得在某些区域航行变得过于危险或是根本不可能。气温已经下降了数度。

尽管有上述灾难，这颗垂死行星的表面的秩序却如梦幻般正常。垮塌建筑留下的瓦砾被缓慢清理，悬浮的灰尘被从最繁忙的街道上清理掉，只要条件允许岩浆流就会被引流改道。民众正在忍耐。
descriptions.en:
Earthquakes are now an almost daily occurrence on most of [Root.GetName], and at least a dozen new supervolcanoes have appeared within the last few years. Massive ash storms blanket the skies, making air travel hazardous or even impossible in some regions. Temperatures have dropped by several degrees.

Despite all this, a surreal sense of normalcy prevails on the dying planet's surface. Rubble from collapsed buildings is slowly removed, the swirling ash is swept off the busiest streets, and the lava flows are, where possible, diverted. The people endure.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]的大部分地区现在几乎每天都会发生地震，过去几年里又出现了至少一打新的超级火山。大量的火山灰遮蔽了天空，使得在某些区域航空飞行变得过于危险或是根本不可能。气温已经下降了数度。

尽管有上述灾难，这颗垂死行星的表面的秩序却如梦幻般正常。垮塌建筑留下的瓦砾被缓慢清理，打转的灰尘被从最为繁忙的街道上扫去，岩浆流只要有可能就会被引流改道。子个体们正在忍受。
descriptions.en:
Earthquakes are now an almost daily occurrence on most of [Root.GetName], and at least a dozen new supervolcanoes have appeared within the last few years. Massive ash storms blanket the skies, making air travel hazardous or even impossible in some regions. Temperatures have dropped by several degrees.

Despite all this, a surreal sense of normalcy prevails on the dying planet's surface. Rubble from collapsed buildings is slowly removed, the swirling ash is swept off the busiest streets, and the lava flows are, where possible, diverted. The drones endure.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]正逐渐四分五裂，行星表面被阴霾笼罩。每一天，地震的震级都在提高，火山灰云变得更为密集。

火山碎屑流和岩浆河在受影响最恶劣的地区已经占据了数座城市。无穷无尽的难民乘坐着拖车穿过持续的火山灰风暴前往安全区，在那里仍能找到文明带来的舒适…至少现在如此。

或许我们尚有一条生路：建造一艘方舟，在末日来临之前，将我们的残余族群送入虚空之中。
descriptions.en:
A perpetual gloom pervades on the surface of [Root.GetName] as the planet slowly rips itself apart. With each passing day, the earthquakes increase in magnitude and the ash clouds grow denser.

Pyroclastic flows and rivers of molten lava have claimed several cities in the worst affected regions. Seemingly endless caravans of refugees are slowly making their way through the constant ash storms to reach safer areas, where the comforts of civilization can still be found... for now.

There may yet be one path of escape: to construct an Arkship and carry what remains of us into the void before the end comes.

[Root.GetName]正逐渐四分五裂，行星表面被阴霾笼罩。每一天，地震的震级都在提高，火山灰云变得更为密集。

火山碎屑流和岩浆河在受影响最恶劣的地区已经占据了数座城市。无穷无尽的难民乘坐着拖车穿过持续的火山灰风暴前往安全区，在那里仍能找到文明带来的舒适…至少现在如此。

A perpetual gloom pervades on the surface of [Root.GetName] as the planet slowly rips itself apart. With each passing day, the earthquakes increase in magnitude and the ash clouds grow denser.

Pyroclastic flows and rivers of molten lava have claimed several cities in the worst affected regions. Seemingly endless caravans of refugees are slowly making their way through the constant ash storms to reach safer areas, where the comforts of civilization can still be found... for now.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]正逐渐四分五裂，阴郁将长时间笼罩在行星表面。每一天，地震的震级都在提高，火山灰云变得更为密集。

火山碎屑流和岩浆河在受影响最恶劣的地区已经占领了多处子个体中心。无穷无尽的子个体乘坐着拖车穿过持续的火山灰风暴前往安全区，在那里会相对安全…至少现在如此。

或许我们尚有一条生路：建造一艘方舟，在末日来临之前，将我们的残余族群送入虚空之中。
descriptions.en:
A perpetual gloom pervades on the surface of [Root.GetName] as the planet slowly rips itself apart. With each passing day, the earthquakes increase in magnitude and the ash clouds grow denser.

Pyroclastic flows and rivers of molten lava have claimed several drone hubs in the worst affected regions. Seemingly endless caravans of drones are slowly making their way through the constant ash storms to reach more remote areas where relative safety can still be found... for now.

There may yet be one path of escape: to construct an Arkship and carry what remains of us into the void before the end comes.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]正逐渐四分五裂，阴郁将长时间笼罩在行星表面。每一天，地震的震级都在提高，火山灰云变得更为密集。

火山碎屑流和岩浆河在受影响最恶劣的地区已经占领了多处子个体中心。无穷无尽的子个体乘坐着拖车穿过持续的火山灰风暴前往安全区，在那里会相对安全…至少现在如此。
descriptions.en:
A perpetual gloom pervades on the surface of [Root.GetName] as the planet slowly rips itself apart. With each passing day, the earthquakes increase in magnitude and the ash clouds grow denser.

Pyroclastic flows and rivers of molten lava have claimed several drone hubs in the worst affected regions. Seemingly endless caravans of drones are slowly making their way through the constant ash storms to reach more remote areas where relative safety can still be found... for now.

label.zh: 这颗行星无法支持生命太久了。
label.en: The planet will not support life much longer.

label.zh: 子个体集群很快就无法继续在这颗行星上工作了。
label.en: Drone units cannot operate on the planet much longer.

label.zh: 立即建造方舟！我们必须逃离，奔向星海！
label.en: Begin Arkship construction. We must take to the stars.

tooltips.zh: 动员所有[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的工业力量建造£arkship£ ['concept_arkship']，解锁['concept_arkship_embark']选项，将那注定湮灭的母星抛诸身后，以£nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empire']之姿于群星间续写文明的篇章。
tooltips.en: Mobilize the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] industries to build an £arkship£ ['concept_arkship'] and unlock the option to ['concept_arkship_embark'], leaving our doomed homeworld behind to live among the stars as a £nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empire'].

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的条件正迅速变得不可忍受。大多数幸存的人口都集中在少数尚余的城市中，这些城市是巨型的防风暴庇护所，足以抵御从不减弱的灰尘的侵袭。但即使是这些文明的最后据点也不会存在太久了。毁灭性的地震仍在持续，千百座活火山喷发着硫磺和熔岩。

在行星地壳碎裂的同时，更多有价值的资源也从地幔涌到了地表，任何剩余的尚能运转的工业均可对这些资源进行加工。
descriptions.en:
Conditions on [Root.GetName] are rapidly becoming unbearable. Most of the remaining population are clustered around the few surviving cities that now serve as massive, fortified storm shelters against the unrelenting ash. But even these last few bastions of civilization on the planet will not survive for long. The devastating earthquakes continue while hundreds of active volcanoes are spewing sulfur and lava.

With the planet's crust disintegrating, more valuable resources have been ejected from the mantle to the surface, where they can be worked by whatever functional industry still remains.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的条件正迅速变得不可忍受。大多数幸存的子个体都集中在少数尚余的基建中心中，这些中心是巨型的防风暴庇护所，足以抵御从未缓和的灰烬侵袭。但即使是行星上这些文明的最后堡垒也不会存在太久了。毁灭性的地震仍在持续，千百座活火山喷发着硫磺和熔岩。

在行星地壳碎裂的同时，更多有价值的资源也从地幔涌到了地表，任何剩余的尚能运转的工业均可对这些资源进行加工。
descriptions.en:
Conditions on [Root.GetName] are rapidly becoming unbearable. Most of the remaining drones are clustered around the few surviving centers of infrastructure that now serve as massive, fortified storm shelters against the unrelenting ash. But even these last few bastions of our civilization on the planet will not survive for long. The devastating earthquakes continue while hundreds of active volcanoes are spewing sulfur and lava.

With the planet's crust disintegrating, more valuable resources have been ejected from the mantle to the surface, where they can be worked by whatever functional industry still remains.

descriptions.zh:
不剩多久了。[Root.GetName]已经开始经历它最后的、灾难性的痉挛，这将最终彻底毁灭这颗行星。我们的科学家预计末日会在一年内到来。

对还困在行星表面的可怜人来说，时间已经所剩无几…
descriptions.en:
It will not be long now. [Root.GetName] is beginning to experience the final cataclysmic convulsions that will result in its utter destruction. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] predict that the end will come in less than a year.

Very little time remains for the poor souls still trapped on the planet's surface...

descriptions.zh:
不剩多久了。[Root.GetName]已经开始经历它最后的、灾难性的痉挛，这将最终彻底毁灭这颗行星。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]预计末日会在一年内到来。

对还困在行星表面的可怜人来说，时间已经所剩无几…

It will not be long now. [Root.GetName] is beginning to experience the final cataclysmic convulsions that will result in its utter destruction. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] predict that the end will come in less than a year.

Very little time remains for the poor drones still trapped on the planet's surface...

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]最终爆炸，终结了这颗行星的苦难。我们原先的母星只剩下碎片，冰冷而毫无生机，纪念着我们的过去。

不幸的是，并非我们的全体公民都已在行星毁灭前从其表面疏散。很难想象世界分崩离析之时他们究竟经历了怎样的恐惧。

不过，现在是面向未来的时候了。在我们重建失去的东西的同时，我们一定要确保他们没有白白牺牲。
descriptions.en:
[Root.GetName] has finally exploded, putting the tormented planet out of its misery. Only fragments of our former homeworld remain, as cold and lifeless monuments of our past.

Unfortunately, not all of our citizens were evacuated from the surface before the planet was destroyed. It is difficult to imagine the horrors they witnessed as their world fell apart around them.

Still, now is the time to look towards the future. As we rebuild what was lost, we must make certain that their sacrifice was not in vain.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]最终爆炸，终结了这颗行星的苦难。我们原先的母星只剩下碎片，冰冷而毫无生机，纪念着我们的过去。

不幸的是，并非我们的全体子个体都已在行星毁灭前从其表面疏散。他们的死亡实在是令人惋惜。

不过，现在是面向未来的时候了。我们必须制造新的子个体以取代他们的原先的位置。
descriptions.en:
[Root.GetName] has finally exploded, putting the tormented planet out of its misery. Only fragments of our former homeworld remain, as cold and lifeless monuments of our past.

Unfortunately, not all of our drones were evacuated from the surface before the planet was destroyed. Their destruction is a regrettable loss.

Still, now is the time to look towards the future. New drones must be produced to replace those that were lost.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]最终爆炸，终结了这颗行星的苦难。我们原先的母星只剩下碎片，冰冷而毫无生机，纪念着我们的过去。

这是一次彻头彻尾的悲剧，我们没能拯救行星上的大多数人。无数公民就此惨死，在行星上最后的文明飞地中蜷缩在一起，看着周遭的世界分崩离析。

不过，我们仍必须前进。在星系中幸存下来的[doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在可以朝着未来进发，希望未来为我们带来的生活会比过去经历的恐怖美好一些。
descriptions.en:
[Root.GetName] has finally exploded, putting the tormented planet out of its misery. Only fragments of our former homeworld remain, as cold and lifeless monuments of our past.

In what can only be described as an utter tragedy, we failed to evacuate most of the planet. Untold numbers of our citizens perished, huddled together in the last surviving enclaves on the surface as their world fell apart around them.

Still, we must carry on. The surviving [doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] in the galaxy can now only look to the future in the hope that it will bring something better than the horrors of the past.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]最终爆炸，终结了这颗行星的苦难。我们原先的母星只剩下碎片，冰冷而毫无生机，纪念着我们的过去。

这是一次彻头彻尾的悲剧，我们没能撤出行星上的大多数子个体。当周遭的世界分崩离析，像无头苍蝇一样游荡在行星表面最后的文明飞地上的无数子个体，迎来了他们的终结。

不过，我们仍必须前进。许多子个体将要被替换，而我们现在只能朝着未来进发，希望未来为我们带来的生活会比过去经历的灾难美好一些。
descriptions.en:
[Root.GetName] has finally exploded, putting the tormented planet out of its misery. Only fragments of our former homeworld remain, as cold and lifeless monuments of our past.

In what can only be described as an utter tragedy, we failed to evacuate most of the planet. Untold numbers of drones perished, loitering without purpose in the last surviving enclaves on the surface as the world fell apart around them.

Still, we must carry on. There are many drones to replace, and we can now only look to the future in the hope that it will bring something better than the disaster of our past.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]最终爆炸，终结了这颗行星的苦难。我们原先的母星只剩下碎片，冰冷而毫无生机，纪念着我们的过去。

我们未能成功逃脱这片孕育了我们物种的重力井。我们的整个文明——我们曾经拥有的一切——都随着这个行星残余的部分化为灰烬。

[doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]成为了星系历史中又一个不幸的注脚，不过如此。
descriptions.en:
[Root.GetName] has finally exploded, putting the tormented planet out of its misery. Only fragments of our former homeworld remain, as cold and lifeless monuments of our past.

We failed in our quest to escape the gravity well that birthed our species. Our entire civilization - all that we were - went up in flames along with the rest of the planet.

And so it was that the [doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] became just another tragic footnote in galactic history.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]最终爆炸，终结了这颗行星的苦难。我们原先的母星只剩下碎片，冰冷而毫无生机，纪念着我们的过去。

我们未能成功逃脱这片承载我们文明兴起的重力井。我们曾经拥有的一切都随着这个行星残余的部分一同在烈焰中化成了灰烬。

[doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]成为了星系历史中又一个不幸的注脚，不过如此。
descriptions.en:
[Root.GetName] has finally exploded, putting the tormented planet out of its misery. Only fragments of our former homeworld remain, as cold and lifeless monuments of our past.

We failed in our quest to escape the gravity well on which our civilization arose. All that we were went up in flames along with the rest of the planet.

And so it was that the [doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] became just another tragic footnote in galactic history.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]爆炸了！或许殖民这样一颗地质结构不稳定的行星是个糟主意…它被抛弃肯定是有原因的。
descriptions.en: [Root.GetName] just exploded! Perhaps colonizing such a tectonically unstable planet was a bad idea... it must have been abandoned for a reason.

label.zh: 或许这已经是最好的结果。
label.en: Perhaps it was for the best.

label.zh: 或许我们本可做到更多……
label.en: Perhaps we could have done more...

label.zh: 我们会记住那些失去的人们的。
label.en: Those we lost will be remembered.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]最终爆炸，终结了这颗行星的苦难。我们原先的母星只剩下碎片，冰冷而毫无生机，纪念着我们的过去。

尽管看着行星毁灭令人伤感，我们大可放心了事，因为我们知道整个行星已经被成功疏散——这本身就是一次辉煌的壮举。

现在是时候重建失去的东西了。如果国家真的兴于忧患，那我们忍受过的试炼一定已让我们变得更为强大。
descriptions.en:
[From.GetName] has finally exploded, putting the tormented planet out of its misery. Only fragments of our former homeworld remain, as cold and lifeless monuments of our past.

As sad as it was to witness its end, we can rest easy in the knowledge that the entire planet was successfully evacuated - a monumental achievement in itself.

It is now time to rebuild that which was lost. If adversity brings strength, then surely we are stronger for the trials we have endured.

descriptions.zh:
第一批殖民者抵达了§H[Root.GetName]§!表面，许多人陷入了情不自禁的狂喜。[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]之外还存在足以支持[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]生存的行星一直是个理论上的可能性，但如果它们极为罕见呢？如果整个星系里都找不到一个呢？又或着假如已经被他人占据该怎么办呢？

这些恐惧现在可以安息了——[Root.GetName]是一颗[Root.GetPlanetMoon]，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]可以在此繁荣昌盛。这些幸运的初始殖民者只是开始，还有不计其数的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]被困在我们那在劫难逃的母星之上。
descriptions.en:
As the first colonists arrive on the surface of §H[Root.GetName]§!, many are overcome with a sense of euphoria. Worlds other than [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] that are capable of supporting [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] life had always been a theoretical possibility, but what if they were exceedingly rare? What if none could be found in our galaxy, or if they had already been claimed by others?

Those fears can be put to rest now - [Root.GetName] is a [Root.GetPlanetMoon] where [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] can thrive. These fortunate groups of initial colonists are a start, but countless [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are still trapped on our doomed homeworld.

descriptions.zh:
§H[Root.GetName]§!按[Root.OWner.GetSpeciesName]的标准来看荒凉又令人不适，但它相对于[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]确实有一个显著的优势—它并不会爆炸。

我们在挣扎中求生，如果这意味着[Root.GetName]需要成为我们的新家园，那就这么办。它会成为安全的避风港，至少直到更好的候选行星被找到为止。尽管[Root.GetPlanetMoon]表面条件严酷，殖民者们仍然是幸运儿。不计其数的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]被困在我们那在劫难逃的母星之上。
descriptions.en:
§H[Root.GetName]§! is a bleak and unpleasant world by [Root.OWner.GetSpeciesName] standards, but it does have one significant advantage over [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] - it is not about to blow up.

This is a struggle for survival, and if that means that [Root.GetName] is to be our new home, then so be it. It shall serve as a safe haven, at the very least until better planetary candidates are found. Despite the harsh conditions on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface, the colonists are the lucky ones. Countless [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are still trapped on our doomed homeworld.

descriptions.zh:
送到§H[Root.GetName]§!的第一个子个体成功地殖民了这颗行星，说明这个新环境能够支持我们集体的生存。我们帝国如今将得以续存：只要我们中的一个活着，我们的集体就会继续存在。

尽管不是必要的，取回那些仍囚禁在注定灭亡的母星上的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]将会非常方便。这些子个体可以进一步发展我们新的家园，将他们遗弃相当浪费。
descriptions.en:
The first drones sent to §H[Root.GetName]§! have successfully colonized the planet, proving the new environment suitable for our collective survival. The continued existence of our empire is now assured: as long as one of us lives, our collective will survive.

Though not essential, it would be convenient to retrieve the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] still trapped on our doomed homeworld. It would be wasteful to abandon drones that could be used to further develop our new home.

descriptions.zh:
§H[From.GetName]§!，[doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]构造不稳定的母星，最终毁于一次爆炸，一次早就被§H[doomsday_owner.GetName]§!所预见的爆炸。

尽管他们发起了一场大规模的撤出行动，但仍有一些居民在终结来临之时未能撤出行星表面。毋庸置疑，他们无人生还。
descriptions.en:
§H[From.GetName]§!, the tectonically unstable homeworld of the [doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], has finally exploded. Its eventual destruction had long been predicted by the §H[doomsday_owner.GetName]§!.

Despite a massive evacuation effort, some of their citizens remained on the planet's surface when it was destroyed. Needless to say, none of them survived.

descriptions.zh:
§H[From.GetName]§!，[doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]构造不稳定的母星，最终毁于一次爆炸，一次早就被§H[doomsday_owner.GetName]§!所预见的爆炸。

尽管他们发起了一场大规模的撤出行动，但仍有一些子个体在终结来临之时未能撤出行星表面。毋庸置疑，他们都灰飞烟灭了。
descriptions.en:
§H[From.GetName]§!, the tectonically unstable homeworld of the [doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], has finally exploded. Its eventual destruction had long been predicted by the §H[doomsday_owner.GetName]§!.

Despite a massive evacuation effort, some of their drones remained on the planet's surface when it was destroyed. Needless to say, they all perished.

descriptions.zh:
§H[From.GetName]§!，[doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]构造不稳定的母星，最终毁于一次爆炸，一次早就被§H[doomsday_owner.GetName]§!所预见的爆炸。

一场计划不周的撤出行动拯救了他们的部分居民，但在周围的世界破裂之时其他的多数似乎仍被遗留在行星表面。预估的死亡人数是灾难性的。
descriptions.en:
§H[From.GetName]§!, the tectonically unstable homeworld of the [doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], has finally exploded. Its eventual destruction had long been predicted by the §H[doomsday_owner.GetName]§!.

A disorganized evacuation effort saved some of their citizens, but the majority seem to have still been on the planet's surface when it disintegrated around them. The projected death toll is catastrophic.

descriptions.zh:
§H[From.GetName]§!，[doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]构造不稳定的母星，最终毁于一次爆炸，一次早就被§H[doomsday_owner.GetName]§!所预见的爆炸。

一场计划不周的撤出行动拯救了他们的部分子个体，但在周围的世界破裂之时其他的多数似乎仍被抛弃在行星表面。
descriptions.en:
§H[From.GetName]§!, the tectonically unstable homeworld of the [doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], has finally exploded. Its eventual destruction had long been predicted by the §H[doomsday_owner.GetName]§!.

A disorganized evacuation effort saved some of their drones, but the majority seem to have been abandoned on the planet's surface when it disintegrated around them.

descriptions.zh:
§H[From.GetName]§!，[doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]构造不稳定的母星，最终毁于一次爆炸，一次早就被§H[doomsday_owner.GetName]§!所预见的爆炸。

尽管他们知道行星将要毁灭，但显然他们没有采取明显的措施来撤出行星。除了一些存活在空间站的零星个体，他们的整个文明都随着他们的母星一起消亡了。
descriptions.en:
§H[From.GetName]§!, the tectonically unstable homeworld of the [doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], has finally exploded. Its eventual destruction had long been predicted by the §H[doomsday_owner.GetName]§!.

Despite this knowledge, they apparently made no significant efforts to evacuate the planet. Aside from a few scattered survivors in space, their entire civilization perished along with their homeworld.

descriptions.zh:
§H[From.GetName]§!，[doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]构造不稳定的母星，最终毁于一次爆炸，一次早就被§H[doomsday_owner.GetName]§!所预见的爆炸。

得益于一场大规模的撤出行动，这颗行星在其毁灭之前就已经被完全放弃了。我们相信没有任何人丧生。
descriptions.en:
§H[From.GetName]§!, the tectonically unstable homeworld of the [doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], has finally exploded. Its eventual destruction had long been predicted by the §H[doomsday_owner.GetName]§!.

Thanks to a massive evacuation effort, the planet had been completely abandoned prior to its destruction. No lives are believed to have been lost.

options.script: name = origin_91.a

descriptions.zh:
自我们宣布夺取自由以来，我们已经历经了许多磨难。那艘载运我们抵达此地的舰船已经被我们发掘出了一切有价值的东西，现在它已经没有什么秘密可言了。

但是，我们决不能忘记过去的牺牲，更不能忘记挣脱镣铐的代价。坠毁的运奴船将被改造成一个公共纪念馆，以纪念我们国家的诞生。
descriptions.en:
We have come a long way since claiming our freedom. The ship we arrived on has been stripped of everything of value, and our technology has advanced to the point that there are few secrets remaining.

But we must never forget the sacrifices of the past, nor the cost of casting off our shackles. The crashed slaver ship will be converted into a public memorial, commemorating the birth of our nation.

descriptions.zh:
自我们抵达此地以来，我们已经经历了许多磨难。尽管我们失去了对那艘载运我们到达此地的飞船的控制权，那艘船上遗留的东西不再对我们有价值，我们的科技也进步到了空前的阶段，那里对我们来说已经不再有什么秘密了。

如果我们有一天将其复原，我们应当把这个地方改成一个纪念馆，以便我们在勇敢地走向未来时，还能记住我们卑微的开始。
descriptions.en:
We have come a long way since our arrival. While we no longer control it, whatever remains on the ship we arrived on is no longer of value to us, and our technology has advanced to the point that there are few secrets remaining.

If we ever recover it, we shall convert the site into a memorial so we remember our humble beginnings as we move boldly into the future.

-§Y坠毁的运奴船§!及相关的基础设施会被转化为先进基础设施。

Unlocks the §YMemorial to the Unshackled§! decision on §Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§!.
- The §YCrashed Slaver Ship§! and related infrastructure will be converted into advanced infrastructure.
- The §YScavenger Sites§! will now provide [clerk.GetIcon] §Y[clerk.GetNamePlural]§! Jobs instead of £job_broken_shackles_scavenger£ §YScavenger§! Jobs.
